## Description

This classic field jacket from Levi's® offers timeless style and practical function.

The Washed Cotton Field Jacket With Plaid Lining pigment-dyed cotton provides a comfortable, lived-in feel right from the start, while details like a contrasting corduroy collar and a cozy plaid lining add heritage appeal.

**Features**

• Classic fit

• Pigment-dyed cotton for a soft, lived-in feel

• Classic field jacket silhouette

• Contrasting corduroy spread collar for a heritage look

• Comfortable and warm plaid polyester lining

• Full button-front closure

• Four front flap pockets for ample storage

• Long sleeves with adjustable button cuffs

**Materials**

• Shell: 100% Cotton

• Lining: 100% Polyester
